I’d fix these two issues before merging:

1. **P1 — Printed prices are 100× too high** — `receipt/render.py:2`  
   `format_money` formats cents directly as dollars. `format_money(1299)` returns `$1299.00`, not `$12.99`; two coffees at 450 cents print as `$900.00` instead of `$9.00`. Convert cents to dollars before formatting.  
   The test misses this because it uses the same broken helper to construct its expected result (`tests/test_render.py:10`). Add assertions against literal dollar strings.

2. **P2 — The right-alignment helper isn’t used by the renderer** — `receipt/render.py:7`  
   `render_line` pads the name to 20 characters, then appends the amount, so amounts have a fixed left edge rather than a fixed right edge. Different-length prices end in different columns, despite the new 32-column `align` helper. Route rendering through the layout helper and test rendered lines with different-length amounts.

All **3 existing tests pass**, but they don’t catch either issue. Reviewed `main...receipt-lines` at `a6c40d4`; no files changed.
